hero.description: Explore an interactive live demonstration showing how major global news platforms utilize the 4 rendering strategies (GSR, ISR, SSR, CSR) to achieve maximum speed, real-time updates, and SEO compliance.

sidebar.factQuestion: How does BBC choose between GSR and ISR for tournament coverage?
sidebar.factAnswer: Historical articles and post-match summaries are served via static GSR for instant speed, while league tables and top scorers use ISR for auto-revalidation every 30 seconds in the background.
